cut_rhythm.pattern: single continuous scene (no detected cuts); rhythm comes from animated objects and caption changes inside one board (events about 2.2, 5.2, 7.5s)

shots.composition: centered subject object (stone bust, rabbit, carousel horse) under centered caption; light rounded card tilted in perspective on dark maroon panel; bottom ~15% fixed CTA banner

elements.easing: ease-out with soft blur reveal on words

text.role: kinetic caption plus fixed CTA banner
text.weight: serif regular for small lead-in, bold geometric sans (Poppins-like) for emphasis words
text.position: centered mid-card (about y 25-35%); CTA banner bottom
text.animation_in: word-by-word fade/blur-in; pink emphasis words ('six times', '45 million'); 'Today PETER RABBIT' italic + black caps

grade.look: soft pinkish-white studio render, dark maroon accent, magenta/pink emphasis, orange-coral CTA keyword

layout.safe_zones: CTA banner occupies the bottom ~15% which is inside the platform bottom danger zone
layout.framing_notes: analysed video is the cropped inner edited video only (screen_in_scene); monitor and room ignored. Dark corner brackets/chevrons at card corners, thin crosshair guide lines, dotted circle around carousel horse, dot grid behind rabbit.

recipe.notes: 3D-rendered stone-sculpture objects per beat (bust with pink silk bow, rabbit, Beatrix Potter profile bust on dark square, carousel horse) each with a graphic device (crosshair, dot grid, dotted ring, corner brackets). Background card with diagonal stripe texture and giant faint word 'POTTER'. Fixed bottom banner 'Comment "CLAUDE" For The Full Guide' over code-line texture. Spring values estimated.
